Fixed at every layer (resolver endpoint, cpp->NuGet, canonical aspose-{family}-foss coordinate rule, facts authoritative, renderer gates on real outcome) and live-verified against the real cells-java repo (commits b6739ad, d881a9b, de7ff3d, 1551bab). aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-Java's disposable Maven build requires a Java 21 toolchain; this execution environment has only JDK 17. BLOCKED_TOOLCHAIN is correctly reported, not a false success. Filed FACT-014 (BACKLOG).
